image_description: A close-up photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with eight overlapping calcareous plates visible on its dorsal surface. The plates are light-colored (whitish/cream) with textured growth lines, surrounded by a reddish-brown leathery girdle. The background shows a dark, wet rocky surface with some small marine organisms.
